caption:
Meta released Muse Spark Open on Thursday, an open-weight AI model with 816 billion parameters.
It is built for coding and AI agents, and Meta says two linked Mac Studios can run it.
The weights are free to download, with limits for big companies.

Would you run a model this big on your own desk?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.

Source: The New Stack

slides.headline: Meta just dropped an open AI model so big it needs *two Mac Studios* to run

slides.heading: 816 billion parameters, *free to download*
paras: Meta released Muse Spark Open on Thursday. It has 816 billion parameters, 42 billion active at a time, and a 1 million token context window. Meta calls it the most capable US open-weight model to date.
It is built for coding and long-running agent tasks. The weights are on Hugging Face now, and providers like Groq, Together AI and OpenRouter offer it too.

slides.heading: A desktop AI with *1TB of memory*
paras: Meta says two M5 Ultra Mac Studios with 512GB each can be linked to run the whole model. Together they act like one machine with a terabyte of memory.
The catch: Apple has not started selling the 512GB Mac Studio yet. Engadget says four 256GB Mac Studios also work, for roughly $38,000.

slides.heading: Aimed straight at *China's* open models
paras: On Meta's own tests, Muse Spark Open beats Chinese models Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3 on agent and tool use tasks.
It still trails them at coding. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, Kimi K3 scored 85.0 and Muse Spark Open scored 76.4.

paras.t: No independent tests have been published yet.

slides.heading: Free, with *strings attached*
paras: The Muse Model License lets many developers use the model for free, even inside their own products. Every product built on it must display 'Built with Muse Spark Open'.
Companies with more than $20 million in yearly revenue need a separate deal with Meta to sell it as a hosted service. Military and critical infrastructure uses are banned.

slides.hook: Meta says the US must not let China lead open AI. Follow to see if Muse Spark Open delivers.
